entries.preserve: Unrelated build, packaging, AMS, printer and functional workflow commits
entries.summary: Studio Atlas visual contract, state inventory, static references and source-inventory checks

registration: The integration owner records each reviewed design-only commit after it exists, excluding functional workflow, AMS, build and packaging changes. This file cannot name its own enclosing commit without a later ledger update.
reversal: Review git show for every listed commit, then use git revert in reverse dependency order. Never reset to the baseline or reverse mixed functional fixes without preserving them.
